notes.title: Next Major Update lands July 10: Save & Place Multiple Avatars!!
notes.content:
Hey gogh players—and everyone who picked us up (or is about to) in the Summer Sale!


Our biggest update yet lands on Thu ✦ July 10—right before the Summer Sale ends!!

Thank you for waiting, Mac users!
You can now play gogh on Macs with Apple Silicon!
We hope you’ll make gogh your new productivity companion on Mac as well.

You’ll notice a new look on the store and in your library.



We’ve also fixed some bugs related to lighting items.

notes.title: 500 Reviews & “Very Positive” — Thank You! A Fresh Look at Our Roadmap
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297920/f42f95049c446b0d46b40978575eae5adf95d887.png
Hey, everyone!

In less than two weeks we’ve hit 25,000 copies sold, 500 reviews, and a “Very Positive” rating above 89 %. Your screenshots of cozy rooms and stylish avatars have been the highlight of our social-media feeds—thank you for sharing them and for playing gogh: Focus with Your Avatar.


Listening—and acting—on your feedback

Between Steam reviews, the community hub, Discord, Google Forms, and social media, we read everything you send us. Thanks to that feedback we rolled out four hotfixes in the first ten days, including a brand-new saturation slider and other quality-of-life tweaks. The next target is better lighting—expect an update soon.


Updated Roadmap

We posted a roadmap the day after launch. Your avalanche of great ideas made us rethink the details, so here’s an updated, more realistic plan. (Some items are still under investigation and may change.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297920/260a65aa95620c30158e1260b501fbad571ad770.png
Already shipped

 Saturation slider
 Rotation-UI toggle in Room Edit
 Pose button on chairs & beds during avatar select
 Mute icon on master-volume slider
 New UI Settings menu
 Performance boosts & minor fixes

Phase 1 — Polish & Options

 Improve avatar body/clothing clipping
 Global lighting overhaul + user controls
 Researching the possibility of having different light levels per light fixture
 Researching the possibility of matching colors across multiple items
 Individual volume bars for ambient noises; more rain variants
 Item bug fixes, UI cleanup, new low-impact graphics options

Phase2 - New Features & Items

 Multiple avatar saves
 Researching the possibility of placing multiple avatars in one room
 New focus-tool options (TBD)
 New room styles, room items, avatar items, playlists
 New weather

Phase3 - Multiplayer

 Feature equivalent to the mobile “Space” mode OR a “Upload/Visit Rooms” function (both under review) *Based on player feedback, we’re evaluating these two directions side by side.

Other

 Mac support
 DLC

Stick with us—gogh is only ten days old and will keep growing.


One last thing!

Launch-discount ends May 14. If you’re still on the fence, now’s the perfect time to jump in.
See you in gogh!

Adding the “Saturation Slider” and Its Impact on Saved Data

To reduce muddiness between original and new colors and to expand creative control, we’ve added a “Saturation Slider” to item recoloring.

Because of this change, some items in rooms or avatars you’ve already created may now appear brighter than before.

We apologize for the inconvenience and ask that you readjust any affected colors.

notes.title: What’s Next for gogh?
notes.content:
To everyone who played the gogh Demo and added it to your wishlist—THANK YOU!!! 🎉

And a huge shoutout to Steam for hosting Next Fest—thanks to this event, gogh has received an incredible amount of attention, and we couldn’t be more grateful!

What’s Next for gogh?

We’re now entering the later stages of development, and thanks to the overwhelming amount of feedback we received from the demo, we’ve mapped out our next steps.

Here’s what we’re focusing on:


 🏠️ Bigger rooms to choose from
 🐶 Dogs & cats (Yes, really!)
 🛠️ Improved room editing controls
 🎭 Better avatar customization controls
 📸 Smoother camera controls
 🎉 More fun when finishing tasks or completing a timer
 🖥️ Support for more aspect ratios
 ⏰ Option for 24-hour clock format
 ✨ Refined UI for a smoother experience
 🐞 Bug fixes & performance improvements
 …and a whole lot more!


And of course, we’re still working on features that were originally planned—including pet nurturing and tons of new items!

About the Pet System 🐾

Don’t worry—this won’t be a system that forces you to do tedious tasks. The pet feature will be designed to enhance your focus, not distract you from it.

Release Date?

We’ll share the release date as soon as it’s finalized!
Make sure to wishlist gogh and stay tuned for more updates! 🚀✨

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
Since the demo was released on February 21, we’ve updated it three times based on everyone’s feedback!

Here are the main fixes:

 Fixed an issue where the game wouldn’t start in certain countries or regions
 Corrected the Traditional Chinese font
 Made it possible to rotate the avatar by dragging the mouse during avatar editing
 Prevented Kuroda42 from growing on its own while the timer is running
 Now only accepts mouse wheel input when hovering over the app window
 Widget positions are reset upon redisplay (temporary fix)
 Added a feature to hide certain UI elements based on the window’s aspect ratio
 Added some new room items
 Fixed a bug where the room item list could become empty
 Updated the count-up timer to support three-digit display
 And more…


If you played right after release and ran into issues, please give it another try!
